test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

When I got an opportunity to start a new business, Ravikanth __queered my pitch.__

options.text: Helped me by standing beside me

solution: The correct answer is **Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"queered my pitch"** means **to spoil someone's plans or chances of success.** (मेरी योजना को बर्बाद कर दिया) • **Example: **Just when I was about to finalize the deal, an unexpected problem **queered my pitch.** • **"Ruined my plan"** refers** to the act of destroying or spoiling a plan or intention. **(मेरी योजना को बर्बाद कर दिया) • **Example: **The sudden rainstorm** ruined my plan** for a picnic. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Ruined my plan. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Advised me** (मुझे सलाह दी): Provided guidance or recommendations. • **Example:** My mentor **advised me** to invest in stocks for better returns. • **Supported me with money** (मुझे पैसे से समर्थन दिया): Provided financial assistance. • **Example:** My parents** supported me with money** to start my own business. • **Helped me by standing beside me** (मेरे साथ खड़े होकर मेरी मदद की): Provided emotional or moral support. • **Example:** My best friend **helped me by standing **beside me during tough times. 44:Tcea, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
